mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, product_name AS productName, product_image AS image, price, quantity, total_amount AS totalPrice, order_no AS orderNo, create_time AS createTime FROM order_item WHERE order_no = #{OrderNo}

SELECT oi.id, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.product_image AS image, oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.total_amount AS totalPrice, oi.order_no AS orderNo, oi.create_time AS createTime FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_no = #{orderNo} AND p.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
